name: ta1al-portfolio
description: Quality tooling for Talal Ahmed's Hugo portfolio.

scripts.validate:site: node scripts/validate-site.mjs public && node scripts/check-asset-budgets.mjs public
scripts.format:check: prettier --check package.json playwright.config.mjs eslint.config.js .stylelintrc.json assets/css assets/js schemas scripts tests
scripts.format:fix: prettier --write package.json playwright.config.mjs eslint.config.js .stylelintrc.json assets/css assets/js schemas scripts tests
scripts.lint: npm run lint:js && npm run lint:css && npm run format:check
scripts.check: npm run validate:data && npm test && npm run lint && npm run build && npm run validate:site
scripts.check:full: npm run check && npm run test:e2e:built
